shoulderedbackpacks water the bagged sandwichesthey followed the winding trail up the cliffside to the walnut grove the air grew cooler under the trees and lizs excitement was palpable the walnut shifting shadows on the mossy ground belowlike walking inside a green cathedral liz dropped to her knees almost immediately reaching for fallen walnuts she picked one up then anotherthe green hulls up as liz held them up grinning sheepishly at the walnut dye smeared across her palms rachel chuckled only save the heavy ones you leave the light ones for the critters lili pulled out her datapad and close whispering with a mischievous smile i see that sparkle in your eyes would be a beautiful place to raise little staple babies rachels face went pink again liz laughed and darted ahead leading we were base brats wed bet on everything back then fighting marksmanship you name it until the war ended we lived on war footing my whole life rachel took it all in so thats where the badass came from liz shrugged modestly mom sent me here to haego because she thought it was safer and honestly im the best at what i do hereselftaught botanist really plants just speak to me i know every species on this rock how they grow what they need its why im good at my job lili raised an eyebrow selftaught thats impressive torres always scanning the landscape and occasionally launching her small waistpouch drone for a quick recon listened quietly rachel asked gently liz were you sent here for spying liz shook her head no not really im genuinely the best botanist on haegomom made sure of that placement but yeah i report back to dad when he asks wyatt knows hes offered to let me hop a shuttle to see my parents for the day more than once once the new datapads arrive ill talk to them properly lili nodded seriously you know i have to report what i hear liz smiled not an issue i was terrified during the drazzan thingwyatt was damn good out therebut enough of that lets keep moving torres showed rachel liz addressed lili can i give one to torres rachel jumped in before lili could answer as council women lady elizabeth and i request torres be our permanent escort on all outings from new town lili came to attention a small smile tugging at her lips lady rachel lady elizabeththat will be up to the sm however she looked at torres who had clearly heard every word im certain if a box happened tesla model y 2023 rwd lfp complete shutdown at 4 soc due to lowvoltage failure with child in vehicle wanted to share a concerning experience i had with my 2023 tesla model y rwd lfp amd while driving back from a trip i was navigating to arrive home with 4 soc started the trip around 29 as soon as i crossed below 5 the car suddenly displayed multiple critical warnings telling me to pull over safely the alerts indicated that the lowvoltage 12v system could not supply enough power and that the vehicle was preparing to shut down i managed to pull over safely but once parked the car completely lost lowvoltage power screens went black doors and handles were inoperable the vehicle was totally unresponsive at the time i also had my 8monthold child in the car which made the situation especially stressful as the vehicle was effectively locked and without power the car had shut down due to a lowvoltage failure i was stuck until a passerby helped with an external 12v booster pack as soon as the booster was connected the car came back to life systems rebooted and i was able to continue my trip and get home the car is now charging and currently functions normally in service mode i saw multiple alerts related to lowvoltage failure including lvbatterycannotsupportvehicle exitdrivelowlvbusvoltage dcdcnotsupportinglvbus vehicle preparing to shut down electrical system power reduced vehicle load shedding active conditions at the time 45 soc cold weather 14c 7f while i understand that power is limited at very low soc and in cold temperatures a complete loss of 12v power including doors seems abnormal for a 2023 vehicle especially with a passenger who cannot exit the vehicle independently this strongly points to a failing or weak 12v battery that could not be supported once the hv battery dropped below a certain threshold ive opened a service ticket with tesla to inspect and likely replace the 12v battery posting this in case it helps others especially lfp owners driving in cold weather and to see if anyone else has experienced something similar

the evolution of electrochemistry in india from early foundations to modern innovation electrochemistry as a discipline bridging chemistry physics and engineering has carved a significant niche in indias scientific landscape emerging in the early twentieth century it transitioned from theoretical explorations to practical applications that bolstered the nations industrial and technological growth this narrative traces the journey of electrochemistry in india highlighting key figures institutions and breakthroughs that shaped its trajectory from conductivity studies in strong electrolytes to advancements in battery technologies and corrosion control the field has influenced sectors like railways space exploration petroleum and chloralkali production today it thrives in various research pockets supported by professional societies dedicated to its promotion pioneers and early developments in electrochemistry the roots of electrochemistry in india can be traced back to the preindependence era where scientific inquiry was often the pursuit of a select few in prestigious institutions one of the earliest and most influential figures was jc ghosh whose work on the conductivity of strong electrolytes laid foundational principles that resonated globally ghoshs research challenged prevailing notions about ion mobility in electrolytes he posited that not all ions in strong electrolytes are free to move due to the influence of electrical charges and only the mobile ions contribute to conductance this idea was revolutionary as it allowed the determination of the active proportion of electrolytes purely from electrical data bypassing the need for the law of mass action ghoshs contributions were not isolated they built upon the global context of electrochemistrys evolution in europe the field had gained momentum at the turn of the 19th century with discoveries like voltas pile and faradays laws of electrolysis by the time these ideas percolated to india ghosh was applying them to refine theories on strong electrolytes his work earned acclaim from luminaries such as william bragg gn lewis walter nernst and max planck and it formed the bedrock for the debyehckel theory despite facing criticism from jr partington which ghosh later rebutted due to an arithmetical error in partingtons analysis ghoshs humility led him to decline a nomination for fellowship of the royal society in 1937 ghosh became the director of the indian institute of science iisc in bangalore succeeding sir cv raman his tenure lasting a decade was instrumental in establishing electrochemistry as a major branch of study in india under his leadership the institute saw an influx of resources and talent dedicated to electrochemical research ghosh was knighted in 1943 for his services to indian science and industrialization underscoring his role in bridging academic pursuits with national development needs the postindependence period marked a surge in electrochemical activities driven by the invention of polarography by jaroslav heyrovsky who won the nobel prize in 1959 for this electroanalytical technique in india this sparked interest leading to the establishment of schools focused on polarography and electrodeposition at iisc rs subramanya led a prominent school on polarography exploring its applications in analytical chemistry parallelly tl ramachar spearheaded research on electrodeposition which involved the deposition of metals onto surfaces using electric currents a technique vital for industries like metallurgy and electronics these early developments were characterized by a focus on enabling research such as measuring electromotive forces emf and conductivities to determine thermodynamic parameters small pockets of activity emerged in centers like iisc and calcutta university where electrochemistry was initially integrated into physical chemistry curricula the transition from theoretical to applied electrochemistry was gradual influenced by indias push for selfreliance after independence the need for indigenous technologies in areas like energy storage corrosion protection and chemical synthesis propelled the field forward philanthropists and visionaries played a crucial role in this era alagappa chettiar for instance envisioned a dedicated national research institute for electrochemistry at a time when the subject was often sidelined in university syllabi his foresight led to the creation of an institution that would become synonymous with electrochemistry in india fostering both fundamental and industrial applications the pioneers work set the stage for a broader adoption of electrochemical techniques for example conductivity measurements evolved from basic experiments to sophisticated analyses that informed electrolyte theories ghoshs emphasis on ion interactions paved the way for understanding phenomena like ionic dissociation and solvation which are central to modern battery designs and electrochemical sensors as india navigated its early postcolonial years electrochemistry began to address practical challenges the railways a lifeline for transportation benefited from electrochemical innovations in battery systems similarly the petroleum industry explored electrochemical methods for refining and corrosion control these applications highlighted the interdisciplinary nature of the field blending chemistry with materials science and engineering the early period also saw challenges such as limited access to advanced equipment researchers often improvised relying on basic setups for emf and conductivity studies despite these constraints the foundational work by ghosh and his contemporaries ensured that electrochemistry gained a foothold preparing the ground for institutional expansions in the following decades the central electrochemical research institute a pillar of industrial electrochemistry the establishment of the central electrochemical research institute cecri in karaikudi tamil nadu marked a watershed moment in indias electrochemical history founded in the postindependence era cecri became the epicenter for electrochemical science and technology steering research towards industrial applications while nurturing fundamental studies ksg doss the institutes formative director was pivotal in shaping its direction doss fostered a culture that balanced theoretical insights with practical innovations influencing generations of electrochemists his research spanned wetting phenomena alternating current ac effects on adsorption and electrode kinetics notably he pioneered tensammetryindependently of breyerand the redoxokinetic effect now known as faradaic rectification these techniques revolutionized adsorption studies kinetics of fast reactions and trace metal electroanalysis dosss interests were eclectic ranging from fundamental concepts like potential of zero charge and electrochemical oscillations to applied problems such as zincair batteries for the indian railways in 1975 the international community honored him with a festschrift in the journal of electroanalytical chemistry recognizing his global impact under subsequent leadership cecri blossomed into asias premier center for electrochemical research its contributions to industry are profound particularly in the chloralkali sector hvk udupas invention of the titanium substrate insoluble anode tsia transformed chloralkali production by replacing traditional graphite anodes with more durable efficient alternatives this technology saved millions in foreign exchange for india as it reduced energy consumption and extended anode lifespan other notable technologies include corrosion control measures exemplified by protections for structures like the pamban bridge duplex coatings for chloralkali equipment enhanced durability against harsh environments polymer electrolyte membrane fuel cells developed at cecri advanced clean energy solutions the institute also established tropical corrosion testing centers to map corrosion patterns across india aiding infrastructure planning in electroorganic synthesis cecri excelled between 1960 and 1980 developing processes for compounds like calcium gluconate glyoxilic acid succinic acid and camphor these were supported by international patents and benefited numerous industries electrometallurgical processes for sodium magnesium and calcium production aided defense and atomic energy sectors today cecris research encompasses corrosion science electrochemical materials power sources pollution control electrochemicals electrodics electrocatalysis electrohydrometallurgy electropyrometallurgy industrial metal finishing nanoscale electrochemistry and instrumentation it collaborates with private industries and government agencies in atomic energy defense environment space transport and ocean development cecri also educates future engineers through its btech program in chemical and electrochemical engineering ensuring a skilled workforce the institutes success stories underscore its role in translating research into tangible benefits such as energyefficient processes and environmental protections the chloralkali industrys transformation is a prime example traditional mercury cells posed environmental risks cecris membrane cells and tsia anodes mitigated these aligning with global sustainability standards in battery technology developments like zincair systems addressed railway signaling needs providing reliable power in remote areas corrosion research at cecri has implications for petroleum pipelines and offshore structures where electrochemical methods like cathodic protection prevent degradation the institutes work on electrochemical perfluorination opened avenues for specialty chemicals used in electronics and pharmaceuticals cecris interdisciplinary approach integrates electrochemistry with materials science enabling innovations like nanostructured electrodes for enhanced performance its pollution control efforts involve electrochemical treatments for wastewater removing heavy metals and organics efficiently the institutes global outreach includes collaborations and technology transfers positioning india as a leader in electrochemical applications by addressing national priorities like energy security and industrial efficiency cecri remains a cornerstone of indias scientific ecosystem the bangalore trio theoretical and applied innovations bangalore emerged as a hub for electrochemistry through the efforts of the bangalore trios sathyanarayana sk rangarajan and sr rajagopalanwhose collective work turned the city into a mecca for the discipline all three had initial traditional security thinking and instead adopt a design philosophy that combines intrinsic security with zero trust the infrastructure layer model layer application layer threelayer security computing power and data nodalized deployment and data containers 1 nodalized deployment is the physical foundation for ensuring computing power and data security the traditional centralized cloud computing model aggregates computing power and data under the control of a single entity constituting inherent single points of failure and trust bottlenecks to address the severe challenges faced by ai agents especially industry agents handling sensitive data nodalized deployment offers a new paradigm of resilient infrastructure its core lies in decomposing vast computing networks into a series of distributed secure nodes with independent trusted execution environments tees then connecting these nodes via trusted ledger technologies like blockchain each node whether in the cloud or at the edge provides a protected sandbox environment for internal code and data processing through its hardware security zones and cryptographic technologies crucially task scheduling no longer relies on reliable physical and trust foundation for computing power and data processing technologies such as distributed message distribution eg nostr peertopeer communication eg libp2p and zeroknowledge defense carrier integrating dynamic access control privacy computing engines and full lifecycle auditing capabilities each data container embeds its datas usage policies purpose limitations and lifecycle rules when an agent needs to process data the principle of moving computation to data not data to computation is followed computational tasks are scheduled to execute within the datas container or a trusted node completing analysis via tee or privacy computing technologies in an encrypted state ensuring raw data remains usable but invisible throughout the process furthermore the sovereignty and precise auditing of compliant data flows this fundamentally resolves the conflict between data silos and privacy in data collaboration allowing highvalue data to safely participate in value exchange while guaranteeing sovereignty 3 from points to plane building a trusted ai agent collaborative network the combination of nodes and data containers ultimately aims to construct a scalable collaborative network for ai agents from discrete points each trusted node equipped with data containers serves as an autonomous ai agent base with security boundaries they interconnect via standard communication protocols and consensus mechanisms forming a decentralized value network within this network agents can safely discover schedule and collaborate across nodes to accomplish complex tasks thus secure individuals organically integrate through standardized interfaces and trusted rules evolving from independent points into a plane possessing robust vitality and resiliencenamely the collaborative network that supports the prosperity of the agent economy 3 trusted algorithms superalignment based on formal verification the superalignment theory proposed by ai pioneer ilya sutskever has pointed the direction for the ai safety industry the core goal of superalignment is to ensure that ais goals and behaviors remain aligned with human values intentions and interests we believe its core lies in model and algorithm security the model layer is where the agents consciousness emerges and is also the deepest most elusive source of its security risks the inherent blackbox nature of large language models unpredictable emergent behaviors and potential circumvention strategies they might develop to achieve goals render traditional evaluation methods based on statistics and testing inadequate facing future superintelligent agents whose mental complexity may far surpass humans how do we ensure the super alignment of their objective functions with human values the answer may lie in infusing algorithms with mathematical certainty we are committed to deeply integrating the methodology of formal verification into the algorithmic security system of ai agents formal methods require us to first transform vague safety requirements eg fairness harmlessness compliance into precisely defined specifications expressed in formal logical language using tools like automated theorem provers or model checkers we then perform exhaustive or symbolic verification of the agents core decision logic potentially its policy network value function or reasoning module proving in a mathematically rigorous manner that under given preconditions the systems behavior will never violate the aforementioned specifications this process deeply resonates with our previous reflections on the incompleteness theorem for ai agents this theorem states that there exists no ultimate instruction capable of perfectly constraining all future behaviors of an agent its behavior is inherently undecidable in complex environments formal verification does not naively pursue a perfect safety model but addresses this incompleteness by delineating clear provable safety boundaries it is akin to carving out trusted paths with solid guardrails within the complex decision forest of an agent for behaviors within these paths we possess mathematically guaranteed certainty for unknown territories beyond the paths we trigger higherlevel monitoring and approval mechanisms this composable safety assurance approach allows us to combine formal proofs for different submodules and safety properties like building blocks gradually constructing a layered progressive trust argument for the complex agent system as a whole formal verification not only provides safety assurance at the model layer but also has broad application potential at the underlying cryptographic algorithm layer especially as quantum computing approaches breakthroughs postquantum secure cryptography based on formal verification can provide more comprehensive security for agent applications with the advancement of quantum computing capabilities currently widespread asymmetric cryptosystems like rsa ecc face the risk of being broken agent systems relying on such algorithms would expose their communication identity authentication and data integrity to significant threats therefore applying formal verification to the design and implementation of postquantum cryptographic algorithms becomes a critical step in building future trusted agent infrastructure through formal methods we can rigorously prove a cryptographic algorithms mathematical correctness security against quantum attacks and properties like the absence of sidechannel leaks during implementation for instance postquantum this article about the purchase of those vehicles and the programs intent i got some questions from redditors and i updated the article and the complete update is below but would love you to visit the site update a public information officer from king county has responded to the questions i received about the programhere are the questions and answers q the august 2025 vanpool program update report mentions a waitlist for participants interested in evs can you tell me how many of the 120 teslas have been assigned to groups or reserved so far is uptake of the vehicles happening at the expected rate how do riders get added to the waitlist for an electric vanpool vehicle a a pilot demonstration with 11 vanpool groups began using the tesla vehicles in the third quarter of 2025 to evaluate the transition to an allelectric fleet and better understand tesla model y usage the current demonstration is expected to be completed by end of february 2026 the remaining vehicles will then cycle into operation with teslas offered to vanpool groups driving older vehicles scheduled for retirement at this time we are not maintaining a signup list for our electric vehicles evs our priority is offering the current ev fleet to vanpool groups operating vehicles already scheduled for retirement this allows us to systematically phase those older models out of service selection for these evs is based on several factors including trip distance employer geographic location and charging accessibility while we expect to place all 120 teslas into service we recognize that a tesla might not fit every groups specific commute to ensure longterm adoption and minimize vehicle turnover the program works with groups to ensure the vehicle remains a sustainable fit q was there testing to ensure the tesla could comfortably accomodate five or more passengers have participant preferences or other factors affected adoption of the evs is there any early feedback on performance maintenance and rider satisfaction for the evs in vanpool use a key factors affecting adoption include charging infrastructure at residences or worksites additionally the seating layout and the third row might not work for some groups early feedback has been largely positive with participants specifically highlighting the vehicles drivability and ease of operation while rider satisfaction remains high some groups have noted comfort challenges regarding the thirdrow seating we are currently in the initial phase of our maintenance and performance evaluation to monitor trends and optimize the vanpool experience q what happens to the vehicles after they reach their end of life do they go to a government auction website a historically king county metro sells retired and surplus vehicles through negotiated direct sales providing a higher yield in returns than traditional public auctions this flexibility is unique to the program assisting in meeting the requirement to recover 100 of its capital and operational expenses and 25 of its program administrative support costs through fare collection and vehicle remarketing revenue as required by king county code vanpool program surplus vehicle direct sales are facilitated through the programs website wwwmetrovansalescom edit tldr eleven teslas are in use in a pilot program and they are replacing internal combustion vehicles as they come to end of life most feedback has been positive though the back two seats in the tesla are said to be tight the program pays for itself with user feesexcept for 75 of admin costs the county was very responsive to my requests
